title: Kosovo Protests Grow Over Killing Of Woman Who Pleaded For Police Protection
content: Protests are spreading across Kosovo after a woman who repeatedly pleaded for protection was killed, allegedly by her brother-in-law. An official investigation found multiple institutional failures, including a prosecutor's refusal to act on a death threat.

title: Russian Drone Strikes Railway Station In Dnipro, Killing At Least 14
content: A Russian drone struck a railway station in Dnipro, killing at least 14 people and injuring others, Ukrainian officials said. The attack hit a platform where a passenger train bound for Zaporizhzhya was standing.

title: 'Life On Every Street': Ukrainians In Kherson Welcome Cease-Fire In Nearby Oleshky
content: A US-brokered cease-fire went into effect on October 27 to let aid arrive in the Russian-occupied suburb of Oleshky and allow civilians to leave.
